item.title: Acti Embeds Agentic AI Directly Into Smartphone Keyboard Layer
item.summary: Acti, a Singapore-based startup, launched an agentic AI keyboard for iOS and Android that embeds multi-step autonomous workflows into the smartphone's text input layer, reportedly raising $5.3 million in seed funding; AI commentator Ronald van Loon amplified the product on X as a notable advance in agentic AI interfaces.
